Total Su", "hn": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

आधार का क्षेत्रफल (Base Area) = 1536 का 37.5% = 3/8 × 1536 = 576 m2

\n

भुजा (a) = √576 = 24 m | LSA = 1536 − 576 = 960 m2

\n

तिर्यक ऊँचाई (l) = LSA ÷ (2 × a) = 960 ÷ 48 = 20 m

\n

ऊँचाई (h) = √(l2 − (a/2)2) = √(202 − 122) = 16 m

\n

आयतन (Volume) = 1/3 × आधार का क्षेत्रफल × ऊँचाई = 1/3 × 576 × 16 = 3072 m3

\n

∴ सही उत्तर 3072 m3 है।

\n

Alternate Method

\n

दिया गया है:

\n

कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (TSA) = 1536 m2

\n

आधार का क्षेत्रफल (B) = 1536 m2 का 37.5%

\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n

1. TSA = आधार का क्षेत्रफल + पार्श्व पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (LSA)

\n

2. LSA = 2 × भुजा × तिर्यक ऊँचाई (l)

\n

3. आयतन (V) = (1/3) × आधार का क्षेत्रफल × ऊँचाई (h)

\n

4. l2 = h2 + (भुजा/2)2

\n\n

गणना:

\n

⇒ आधार का क्षेत्रफल (B) = 37.5/100 × 1536 = 3/8 × 1536 = 576 m2

\n

⇒ माना वर्गाकार आधार की भुजा 'a' है।

\n

⇒ a2 = 576 ⇒ a = √576 = 24 m

\n

⇒ पार्श्व पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (LSA) = TSA − आधार का क्षेत्रफल = 1536 − 576 = 960 m2

\n

⇒ 2 × a × l = 960 ⇒ 2 × 24 × l = 960

\n

⇒ 48 × l = 960 ⇒ l = 960 / 48 = 20 m

\n

⇒ ऊँचाई (h) के लिए पाइथागोरस प्रमेय का उपयोग करने पर:

\n

⇒ h2 = l2 − (a/2)2 = 202 − (24/2)2

\n

⇒ h2 = 400 − 122 = 400 − 144 = 256

\n

⇒ h = √256 = 16 m

\n

⇒ आयतन (V) = (1/3) × 576 × 16

\n

⇒ V = 192 × 16 = 3072 m3

\n

∴ सही उत्तर 3072 m3 है।

\n

Additional Information

\n

पिरामिड का आयतन

\n

किसी भी पिरामिड का आयतन V = (1/3) × आधार का क्षेत्रफल × ऊर्ध्वाधर ऊँचाई द्वारा दिया जाता है।

\n

वर्गाकार पिरामिड का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल

\n

कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = a2 + 2al, जहाँ 'a' आधार की भुजा है और 'l' तिर्यक ऊँचाई है।

\n

तिर्यक ऊँचाई बनाम ऊर्ध्वाधर ऊँचाई

\n

एक लंब वर्गाकार पिरामिड के लिए, l2 = h2 + (a/2)2 जहाँ l तिर्यक ऊँचाई है, h ऊर्ध्वाधर ऊँचाई है, और a आधार की भुजा है।

चौरस-आधारित लंब पिरॅमिडचे एकूण पृष्ठफळ 1536 मीटर2 आहे.

\n\n

पाया क्षेत्रफळाची टक्केवारी: 37.5%

\n\n

वापरलेले सूत्र:

\n\n

⇒ l2 = (बाजू/2)2 + (उंची)2

\n\n

जिथे, l = तिरकस उंची.

\n\n

पार्श्व पृष्ठफळ = 1/2 × पायाची परिमिती × तिरकस उंची

\n\n

पिरॅमिडचे घनफळ (1/3) × पायाचे क्षेत्रफळ × उंची आहे.

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

पायाचे क्षेत्रफळ = 0.375 × एकूण पृष्ठफळ = 0.375 × 1536 = 576 मीटर2

\n\n

चौरसाची बाजू = √576 = 24 मीटर 

\n\n

पार्श्व पृष्ठफळ = एकूण पृष्ठफळ - पायाचे क्षेत्रफळ = 1536 - 576 = 960 मीटर2.

\n\n

पार्श्व पृष्ठफळ = 1/2 × 24 × 4 × तिरकस उंची

\n\n

⇒ 960 = 1/2 × 24 × 4 × तिरकस उंची

\n\n

तिरकस उंची = 20 मीटर 

\n\n

पायथागोरियन प्रमेय पासून,

\n\n

तिरकस उंची (l) = √(उंची2 + (बाजू/2)2)

\n\n

⇒ 20 = √(उंची2 + 122)

\n\n

⇒ 202 = उंची2 + 144

\n\n

उंची2 = 400 - 144 = 256

\n\n

उंची = 16 मीटर 

\n\n

पिरॅमिडचे घनफळ (1/3) × पायाचे क्षेत्रफळ × उंची आहे

\n\n

घनफळ = (1/3) × 576 × 16

\n\n

⇒ 192 × 16

\n\n

 

\n\n

⇒ 3072 मीटर3

\n\n

 

\n\n

∴ पर्याय 2 हे योग्य उत्तर आहे.

গণনা:

\n\n

ভূমির ক্ষেত্রফল = 0.375 x মোট পৃষ্ঠের ক্ষেত্রফল = 0.375 x 1536 = 576 মিটার2

বর্গক্ষেত্রের বাহু = √576 = 24 মিটার

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

উচ্চতা = 16 মিটার 

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ 192 x 16

\n\n

 

\n\n

கணக்கீடு:

\n\n

அடிப்படை பரப்பளவு = 0.375 x மொத்த மேற்பரப்பு பரப்பளவு = 0.375 x 1536 = 576 m2

\n\n

சதுரத்தின் பக்கம் = √576 = 24 m

\n\n

பக்கவாட்டு மேற்பரப்பு பரப்பளவு = மொத்த மேற்பரப்பு பரப்பளவு - அடிப்படை பரப்பளவு = 1536 - 576 = 960 m2.

\n\n

பக்கவாட்டு மேற்பரப்பு பரப்பளவு = 1/2 x 24 x 4 x சாய்வு உயரம்

\n\n

⇒ 960 = 1/2 x 24 x 4 x சாய்வு உயரம்

\n\n

சாய்வு உயரம் = 20 m

\n\n

பித்தகோரஸ் தேற்றத்திலிருந்து,

\n\n

சாய்வு உயரம் (l) = √(உயரம்2 + (பக்கம்/2)2)

\n\n

⇒ 20 = √(உயரம்2 + 122)

\n\n

⇒ 202 = உயரம்2 + 144

\n\n

உயரம்2 = 400 - 144 = 256

\n\n

உயரம் = 16 m

\n\n

பிரமிட்டின் கன அளவு = (1/3) x அடிப்படை பரப்பளவு x உயரம்

\n\n

கன அளவு = (1/3) x 576 x 16

\n\n

⇒ 192 x 16

\n\n

 

\n\n

⇒ 3072 m3

\n\n

 

\n\n

∴ விருப்பம் 2 சரியான விடை.

Its surface area (in cm2) is:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "16847"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "12474"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "17424"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "14274"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक गोले का आयतन 130977 cm3 द्वारा दिया गया है। इसका पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (cm2 में) है:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "16847"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "12474"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "17424"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "14274"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Given:

\n\n

Volume of sphere = 130977 cm3

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

First calculate the radius of the sphere then proceed to find the surface area.

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πR3

\n\n

Surface area of sphere = 4πR2

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πR3

\n\n

⇒ (4/3) πR3  = 130977

\n\n

⇒ R3 = 130977 × (3/4) × (7/22)

\n\n

⇒ R3 = 1488.375 × 21

\n\n

⇒ R = 31.5 cm

\n\n

Surface area of sphere = 4πR2

\n\n

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × 31.5 × 31.5

\n\n

⇒ 12474 cm2

\n\n

∴ The surface area of the sphere is 12474 cm2. 

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

गोले का आयतन = 130977 cm3

\n\n

संकल्पना:

\n\n

पहले गोले की त्रिज्या की गणना कीजिए, तब पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात करने के लिए आगे बढ़ते हैं।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

गोले का आयतन = (4/3)πR3

\n\n

गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 4πR2

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

गोले का आयतन = (4/3)πR3

\n\n

⇒ (4/3) πR3  = 130977

\n\n

⇒ R3 = 130977 × (3/4) × (7/22)

\n\n

⇒ R3 = 1488.375 × 21

\n\n

⇒ R = 31.5 cm

\n\n

गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 4πR2

\n\n

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × 31.5 × 31.5

\n\n

⇒ 12474 cm2

\n\n

∴ गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 12474 cm2 है।

Solution:Given:

\n\n

Radius of the circle, OA = 5 cm

\n\n

Length of AB = 12 cm

\n\n

Concept:

\n\n

In a circle, a radius drawn to the point of tangency is perpendicular to the tangent line.

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

\n\n

Triangle OAB is a right triangle with right angle at A.

\n\n

Use the Pythagorean theorem to find the length of OB.

\n\n

Once OB is known, it's easy to find BR using the fact that OR = OA = 5 cm (radii of the same circle).

\n\n

OB = √(OA2 + AB2)

\n\n

⇒ √(52 + 122) = √(25 + 144)

\n\n

⇒ √169 = 13 cm.

\n\n

Since OR = OA = 5 cm, BR = OB - OR = 13 - 5 = 8 cm.

\n\n

Therefore, the length of BR is 8 cm.

दिया गया है:

\n\n

\n\n

संकल्पना:

\n\n

एक वृत्त में, स्पर्श रेखा बिंदु पर खींची गई त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा रेखा के लंबवत होती है।

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

\n\n

त्रिभुज OAB एक समकोण त्रिभुज है जिसका कोण A पर समकोण है।

\n\n

OB की लंबाई ज्ञात करने के लिए पाइथागोरस प्रमेय का प्रयोग कीजिए।

\n\n

एक बार OB ज्ञात हो जाने पर, इस तथ्य का प्रयोग करके BR को ज्ञात करना आसान है कि OR = OA = 5 cm (समान वृत्त की त्रिज्या)।

\n\n

OB = √(OA2 + AB2)

\n\n

⇒ √(52 + 122) = √(25 + 144)

\n\n

⇒ √169 = 13 cm.

\n\n

चूँकि OR = OA = 5 cm, BR = OB - OR = 13 - 5 = 8 cm

\n\n

इसलिए, BR की लंबाई 8 cm है।

ABର ଦୈର୍ଘ୍ୟ = 12 ସେମି

\n\n

ଧାରଣା:

\n\n

ଏକ ବୃତ୍ତରେ, ସ୍ପର୍ଶ ବିନ୍ଦୁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଟାଣିଥିବା ବ୍ୟାସାର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ପର୍ଶକ ରେଖା ସହିତ ଲମ୍ବ ହୋଇଥାଏ।

\n\n

ଗଣନା:

\n\n

\n\n

ତ୍ରିଭୁଜ OAB ହେଉଛି Aରେ ସମକୋଣ ସହିତ ଏକ ସମକୋଣୀ ତ୍ରିଭୁଜ।

\n\n

OBର ଦୈର୍ଘ୍ୟ ବାହାର କରିବା ପାଇଁ ପାଇଥାଗୋରାସ୍ ଉପପାଦ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

\n\n

ଥରେ OB ଜଣାପଡିଲେ, OR = OA = 5 ସେମି (ସମାନ ବୃତ୍ତର ବ୍ୟାସାର୍ଦ୍ଧ) ହୋଇଥିବା ହେତୁ BR ବାହାର କରିବା ସହଜ ଅଟେ।

\n\n

OB = √(OA2 + AB2)

\n\n

⇒ √(52 + 122) = √(25 + 144)

\n\n

⇒ √169 = 13 ସେମି।

\n\n

ଯେହେତୁ OR = OA = 5 ସେମି, BR = OB - OR = 13 - 5 = 8 ସେମି।

\n\n

ତେଣୁ, BRର ଦୈର୍ଘ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି 8 ସେମି।

\nपिछले सात वर्षों में किस प्रकार की बैटरी की कुल बिक्री सबसे अधिक रही?\n35:T668,\n

\n\n

\n\n

Total sales of 7AH battery over the last seven years = 144 + 126 + 114 + 90 + 75 + 60 + 85 = 694

\n\n

Total sales of 32AH battery over the last seven years = 114 + 102 + 75 + 150 + 135 + 165 + 160 = 901

\n\n

Total sales of 35AH battery over the last seven years = 102 + 84 + 105 + 90 + 75 + 45 + 100 = 601

\n\n

Total sales of 55AH battery over the last seven years = 108 + 126 + 135 + 75 + 90 + 120 + 145 = 799

\n\n

∴ Battery had the highest total sales over the last seven years is 32AH.

\n\n

∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.

If the number of plastic boxes is increased by 25%, then what will be the number of plastic boxes now?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "144"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "360"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "216"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "180"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक कंपनी तीन प्रकार के बक्से बना रही है - प्लास्टिक, लकड़ी और कांच। प्लास्टिक, लकड़ी और कांच के बक्सों की संख्या का अनुपात 2: 3: 5 है। लकड़ी और कांच के बक्सों की संख्या के बीच का अंतर 144 है। यदि प्लास्टिक के बक्सों की संख्या 25% बढ़ जाती है, तो अब प्लास्टिक के बक्सों की संख्या क्या होगी?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "144"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "360"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "216"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "180"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "or": {"value": "ଏକ କମ୍ପାନୀ ତିନି ପ୍ରକାରର ବକ୍ସ ତିଆରି କରୁଛି - ପ୍ଲାଷ୍ଟିକ୍, କାଠ ଏବଂ କାଚ। ପ୍ଲାଷ୍ଟିକ୍, କାଠ ଏବଂ କାଚ ବକ୍ସର ସଂଖ୍ୟାର ଅନୁପାତ 2: 3: 5। କାଠ ଏବଂ କାଚ ବକ୍ସର ସଂଖ୍ୟାର ପାର୍ଥକ୍ୟ 144। ଯଦି ପ୍ଲାଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ବକ୍ସର ସଂଖ୍ୟା 25% ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଏ, ତେବେ ଏବେ ପ୍ଲାଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ବକ୍ସର ସଂଖ୍ୟା କେତେ ହେବ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "144"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "360"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "216"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "180"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "

Given:

\n\n

Ratio of plastic:wood:glass = 2:3:5

\n\n

Difference between wood and glass = 144

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

⇒ Wood - Glass = 144

\n\n

⇒ Ratio difference between wood and glass = 5 - 3 = 2 parts

\n\n

⇒ 2 parts = 144

\n\n

⇒ 1 part = 72

\n\n

⇒ Plastic boxes (2 parts) = 2 × 72 = 144

\n\n

Increase plastic by 25%:

\n\n

New plastic = 144 + (25% of 144)

\n\n

⇒ 144 + (0.25 × 144)

\n\n

⇒ 144 + 36

\n\n

⇒ 180

\n\n

∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.

\n", "hn": "

दिया गया है:

\n\n

प्लास्टिक:लकड़ी:कांच का अनुपात = 2:3:5

\n\n

लकड़ी और कांच के बीच अंतर = 144

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

⇒ लकड़ी - कांच = 144

\n\n

⇒ लकड़ी और कांच के बीच अनुपात अंतर = 5 - 3 = 2 भाग

\n\n

⇒ 2 भाग = 144

\n\n

⇒ 1 भाग = 72

\n\n

{"prompt": "2", "value": "81"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "27"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "47"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

If x + 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 − 2.

\n

Similarly, x4 + 1/x4 = (k2 − 2)2 − 2.

\n

Here, a + 1/a = 3, so k = 3.

\n

a2 + 1/a2 = 32 − 2 = 9 − 2 = 7.

\n

a4 + 1/a4 = 72 − 2 = 49 − 2 = 47.

\n

∴ The correct answer is 47.

\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

a + 1/a = 3

\n

Formula Used:

\n

(x + y)2 = x2 + y2 + 2xy

\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Squaring both sides of the given equation:

\n

⇒ (a + 1/a)2 = 32

\n

⇒ a2 + 1/a2 + 2(a)(1/a) = 9

\n

⇒ a2 + 1/a2 + 2 = 9

\n

⇒ a2 + 1/a2 = 9 − 2

\n

⇒ a2 + 1/a2 = 7

\n

⇒ Squaring both sides again:

\n

⇒ (a2 + 1/a2)2 = 72

\n

⇒ a4 + 1/a4 + 2(a2)(1/a2) = 49

\n

⇒ a4 + 1/a4 + 2 = 49

\n

⇒ a4 + 1/a4 = 49 − 2

\n

⇒ a4 + 1/a4 = 47

\n

∴ The correct answer is 47.

\n

Additional Information

\n

Algebraic Identity for Cubes

\n

If x + 1/x = k, then x3 + 1/x3 = k3 − 3k.

\n

Algebraic Identity for Subtraction

\n

If x − 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 + 2.

\n

Algebraic Identity for Fifth Power

\n

If x + 1/x = k, then x5 + 1/x5 = (x2 + 1/x2)(x3 + 1/x3) − (x + 1/x).

Given:

\n\n

Radius (r = 5) cm

\n\n

Slant height (l = 13) cm

\n\n

Formula:

\n\n

The volume of cone =\\( \\frac{1}{3} π r^2 h\\)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

To find height (h), use Pythagoras theorem since (r), (l), and (h) form a right-angled triangle:

\n\n

l2 = h2 + r2

\n\n

⇒ 132 = h2 = 52

\n\n

⇒ h2 = 169 - 25

\n\n

⇒ h2 = 144

\n\n

⇒ h =12

\n\n

Now,

\n\n

⇒ V = 1/3 × π × 52 × 12

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

2019-2020 के दौरान न्यूजीलैंड और पाकिस्तान के विरुद्ध बनाए गए कुल रनों और 2020-2021 के दौरान श्रीलंका और पाकिस्तान के विरुद्ध बनाए गए कुल रनों के बीच अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।

Solution:

\n\n

Runs scored against New Zealand during 2019-2020 = 14/100 × 4000 = 560 runs

\n\n

Runs scored against Pakistan during 2019-2020 = 16/100 × 4000 = 640 runs

\n\n

Total runs scored against New Zealand and Pakistan during 2019-2020 = 560 + 640 = 1200 runs

\n\n

Runs scored against Sri Lanka during 2020-2021 = 20/100 × 5000 = 1000 runs

\n\n

Runs scored against Pakistan during 2020-2021 = 15/100 × 5000 = 750 runs

\n\n

Total runs scored against Sri Lanka and Pakistan during 2020-2021 = 1000 + 750 = 1750 runs

\n\n

Required difference = 1750 - 1200 = 550 runs

\n\n

∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.

\n\n

2019-2020 के दौरान पाकिस्तान के विरुद्ध बनाए गए रन = 16/100 × 4000 = 640 रन

\n\n

\n\n

2020-2021 के दौरान श्रीलंका के विरुद्ध बनाए गए रन = 20/100 × 5000 = 1000 रन

\n\n

2020-2021 के दौरान पाकिस्तान के विरुद्ध बनाए गए रन = 15/100 × 5000 = 750 रन

\n\n

2020-2021 के दौरान श्रीलंका और पाकिस्तान के विरुद्ध बनाए गए कुल रन = 1000 + 750 = 1750 रन

\n\n

अभीष्ट अंतर = 1750 - 1200 = 550 रन

\n\n

∴ विकल्प 4 सही उत्तर है।

Given:

\n\n

Ratio of two numbers = 12 : 7

\n\n

HCF = 25

\n\n

Formula:

\n\n

Numbers = (HCF × Ratio part)

\n\n

Solution:

\n\n

First number = 25 × 12 = 300

\n\n

Second number = 25 × 7 = 175

\n\n

Numbers are 300 and 175.

\n", "hn": "

दिया गया है:

\n\n

दो संख्याओं का अनुपात = 12 : 7

\n\n

महत्तम समापवर्तक = 25

\n\n

सूत्र:

\n\n

संख्याएँ = (महत्तम समापवर्तक × अनुपात भाग)

\n\n

हल:

\n\n

पहली संख्या = 25 × 12 = 300

\n\n

दूसरी संख्या = 25 × 7 = 175

\n\n

संख्याएँ 300 और 175 हैं।

\n", "te": "

ఇచ్చినవి:

\n\n

రెండు సంఖ్యల నిష్పత్తి = 12 : 7

\n\n

HCF = 25

\n\n

సూత్రం:

\n\n

సంఖ్యలు = (HCF x నిష్పత్తి భాగం)

\n\n

సొల్యూషన్:

\n\n

మొదటి సంఖ్య = 25 x 12 = 300

\n\n

రెండవ సంఖ్య = 25 x 7 = 175

\n\n

సంఖ్యలు 300 మరియు 175.

\n", "mr": "

दिलेले आहे:

\n\n

दोन संख्यांचे गुणोत्तर = 12 : 7

\n\n

मसावि = 25

\n\n

सूत्र:

\n\n

संख्या = (मसावि × गुणोत्तर भाग)

\n\n

समाधान:

\n\n

पहिली संख्या = 25 × 12 = 300

\n\n

दुसरी संख्या = 25 × 7 = 175

\n\n

त्या संख्या 300 आणि 175 आहेत.

\n", "bn": "

প্রদত্ত:

\n\n

দুটি সংখ্যার অনুপাত = 12 : 7

\n\n

HCF = 25

\n\n

সূত্র:

\n\n

সংখ্যা = (HCF x অনুপাতের অংশ)

\n\n

সমাধান:

\n\n

প্রথম সংখ্যা = 25 x 12 = 300

\n\n

দ্বিতীয় সংখ্যা = 25 x 7 = 175

\n\n

সংখ্যা দুটি হল 300 এবং 175.

\n", "ml": "", "gu": "

આપેલ:

\n\n

બે સંખ્યાઓનો ગુણોત્તર = 12 : 7

\n\n

ગુ. સા. અ = 25

\n\n

સૂત્ર:

\n\n

સંખ્યાઓ = (ગુ. સા. અ x ગુણોત્તર ભાગ)

\n\n

\n\n

બીજી સંખ્યા = 25 x 7 = 175

\n\n

સંખ્યાઓ 300 અને 175 છે.

\n", "kn": "", "ta": "

கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

\n\n

இரண்டு எண்களின் விகிதம் = 12 : 7

\n\n

மீ.பொ.வ = 25

\n\n

சூத்திரம்:

\n\n

எண்கள் = (மீ.பொ.வ x விகிதப் பகுதி)

\n\n

தீர்வு:

இரண்டாவது எண் = 25 x 7 = 175

\n\n

எண்கள் 300 மற்றும் 175.

Given 

\n\n

Speed of boat in still water = 6 km/h

\n\n

Speed of stream = 2.5 km/h

\n\n

Distance taken = 59.5 km

\n\n

Formula Used

\n\n

If speed of a boat in still water is u km/h and the speed of the stream is v km/h. Then,

\n\n

Speed upstream = (u - v)km/h

\n\n

Speed downstream = (u + v) km/h

\n\n

Calculation

\n\n

Boat’s upstream speed = 6 – 2.5 = 3.5 km/h

\n\n

Boats downstream speed = 6 + 2.5 = 8.5 km/h

\n\n

⇒Total time = (59.5/8.5) + (59.5/3.5) = 7 + 17 = 24 hrs.

\n\n

∴ Total time is 24 hrs.

\n\n

∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.

", "hn": "\n

\n\n

तय की गई दूरी = 59.5 km

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र

\n\n

यदि शांत जल में नाव की चाल u km/h है और धारा की चाल v km/h है। तब,

धारा के प्रतिकूल Given:

\n\n

Earnings in consecutive four days = ₹5,445, ₹5,937, ₹5,865 and ₹6,562

\n\n

Average sale after 5th day = ₹6,050

\n\n

Concept Used:

\n\n

Average = Total sum of values ÷ Number of values

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

⇒ Total sales for 4 days = ₹5,445 + ₹5,937 + ₹5,865 + ₹6,562 = ₹23,809

\n\n

⇒ Total sales for 5 days = ₹6,050 × 5 = ₹30,250

\n\n

⇒ Sale on the fifth day = Total sales for 5 days - Total sales for 4 days = ₹30,250 - ₹23,809 = ₹6,441

\n\n

The sale on the fifth day is ₹6,441.

\n\n

∴ The sale required for the 5th day is ₹ 6,441

\n\n

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

⇒ 4 दिनों की कुल बिक्री = ₹5,445 + ₹5,937 + ₹5,865 + ₹6,562 = ₹23,809

\n\n

⇒ 5 दिनों की कुल बिक्री = ₹6,050 × 5 = ₹30,250

\n\n

⇒ पांचवें दिन की बिक्री = 5 दिनों की कुल बिक्री - 4 दिनों की कुल बिक्री = ₹30,250 - ₹23,809 = ₹6,441

\n\n

पांचवें दिन की बिक्री ₹6,441 है।

\n\n

∴ 5वें दिन के लिए अभीष्ट बिक्री ₹ 6,441 है

\n\n

Cost of 2nd variety = ₹ 25 per kg

\n\n

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let the ratio of 1st variety to 2nd variety be "1 : x"

\n\n

⇒ 1 × 12 + x × 25 = (1 + x) 20

\n\n

⇒ 12 + 25x = 20 + 20x

\n\n

⇒ 25x - 20x = 20 - 12

\n\n

⇒ 5x = 8

\n\n

⇒ 5/8 = 1/x

\n\n

⇒ 5 : 8 = 1 : x

\n\n

∴ The ratio is 5 : 8.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n\n

∴ The ratio of 1st variety to 2nd variety is 5 : 8

दिया गया है:

\n\n

A और B, ₹36,000 का एक प्रोजेक्ट लेते हैं।

\n\n

A कार्य को 25 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त संकल्पना:

\n\n

कुल कार्य = समय × दक्षता

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

25 दिनों में A 100% कार्य पूरा कर सकता है।

\n\n

इसलिए, एक दिन में A, 4% कार्य कर सकता है।

\n\n

A ने कुल मिलाकर 10 दिन कार्य किया है।

\n\n

A ने 10 दिनों में 40% कार्य पूरा कर लिया है।

\n\n

\\([P = \\frac{A}{(1 + \\frac{r}{n})^{nt}}]\\)

दिया गया है:

गणना:

\n\n

Given:

\n\n

Distance between inspector and thief initially: 288 meters

\n\n

Inspector's speed: 42 meters/minute

\n\n

Thief's speed: 30 meters/minute

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Relative speed = Inspector's speed - Thief's speed

\n\n

Time taken = Initial distance / Relative speed

\n\n

Calculations:

\n\n

Relative speed = 42 - 30 = 12 meters/minute

\n\n

Time taken = 288 meters / 12 meters/minute = 24 minutes

\n\n

The inspector will catch the thief in 24 minutes.

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

सापेक्ष चाल = इंस्पेक्टर की चाल - चोर की चाल

ଦିଆଯାଇଛି:

ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଭାବରେ ଇନ୍ସପେକ୍ଟର ଏବଂ ଚୋର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଦୂରତା: 288 ମିଟର

ଇନ୍ସପେକ୍ଟରଙ୍କ ବେଗ: ୪୨ ମିଟର/ମିନିଟ୍

ଚୋରଙ୍କ ଗତି: 30 ମିଟର/ମିନିଟ୍

ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ସୂତ୍ର:

ଆପେକ୍ଷିକ ଗତି = ଇନ୍ସପେକ୍ଟରଙ୍କ ଗତି - ଚୋରଙ୍କ ଗତି

ନିଆଯାଇଥିବା ସମୟ = ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଦୂରତା / ଆପେକ୍ଷିକ ବେଗ

ଗଣନା:

ଆପେକ୍ଷିକ ବେଗ = ୪୨ - ୩୦ = ୧୨ ମିଟର/ମିନିଟ୍

ନିଆଯାଇଥିବା ସମୟ = ୨୮୮ ମିଟର / ୧୨ ମିଟର/ମିନିଟ୍ = ୨୪ ମିନିଟ୍

ଇନ୍ସପେକ୍ଟର ୨୪ ମିନିଟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଚୋରକୁ ଧରି ପକାଇବେ।

Given:

\n\n

Final cost after 20% commission deducted = ₹9,080

\n\n

Commission rate = 20%

\n\n

Formula to use:

\n\n

Final Price = Marked Price - (Commission Rate × Marked Price)

\n\n

Solution:

\n\n

⇒ 9080 = MP - (0.2 × MP)

\n\n

⇒ 9080 = MP(1 - 0.2)

\n\n

⇒ 9080 = MP × 0.8

\n\n

⇒ MP = 9080/0.8 

\n\n

⇒ MP = 11350

\n\n

The marked price is ₹11,350.

\n", "hn": "

दिया गया है:

\n\n

20% कमीशन कटौती के बाद अंतिम मूल्य = ₹9,080

\n\n

कमीशन दर = 20%

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

अंतिम मूल्य = अंकित मूल्य - (कमीशन दर × अंकित मूल्य)

\n\n

हल:

\n\n

⇒ 9080 = MP - (0.2 × MP)

\n\n

⇒ 9080 = MP(1 - 0.2)

\n\n

⇒ 9080 = MP × 0.8

\n\n

⇒ MP = 9080/0.8 

\n\n

⇒ MP = 11350

\n\n

अंकित मूल्य ₹11,350 है।

      Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

      \n\n

      Burn one’s bridges

      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Working very hard"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Impossible to return to an earlier state&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Having an overnight success&nbsp;"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Attack on one&rsquo;s enemy"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is Option 2 i.e. Impossible to return to an earlier state.
      \nKey Points\n\n
        \n\t
      • The idiom "Burn one's bridges" means to do something that makes it impossible to go back to the previous situation. \n\n\t
          \n\t\t
        • Example: After arguing with his boss and quitting his job so abruptly, Jake realized he had burned his bridges and ask for his job back.
          • \n\t
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • The correct meaning of the idiom, "Impossible to return to an earlier state," refers to a situation or action from which one cannot return or revert.\n\t
          \n\t\t
        • Example: When she publicly criticized her company in social media, she effectively burned her bridges with her employer.
          • \n\t
        \n\t
        • \n
      \n\n

      Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Impossible to return to an earlier state.'

      \nAdditional Information\n\n
        \n\t
      • Option 1: Working very hard  refers to putting a lot of effort into a task. This does not relate to the idiom's meaning of making a situation irreversible.
        • \n\t
      • Option 3: Having an overnight success implies achieving success very quickly, which is unrelated to the concept of burning one's bridges.
        • \n\t
      • Option 4: Attack on oneundefineds enemy suggests a direct confrontation or aggression towards an adversary, which is not connected to the irreversible decision implied by the idiom.
        • \n

                        The correct answer is Option 4) "through hand."

                        \nKey Points

                          \n\t
                        • The error lies in the prepositional phrase "through hand," which is not the correct idiomatic expression for indicating direct delivery by a person.

                        • The correct phrase should be "by hand," which means delivering something personally rather than through mechanical or electronic means.
                          • \n\t

                          • \n
                        \n\n

                        The correct answer is Option 4) "estimate."

                          • \n\t
                        • Option 3) "conceal" means to keep something hidden or secret, which contradicts the context of trying to assess or determine value

                        \nKey Points\n\n

                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: Many vegans also avoid products that are tested on animals or made from animal skins.

                            \n\t\t

                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n
                        \n\n

                        \nAdditional Information\n\n
                          \n\t

                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: Vegetarians often have to check if food products contain any hidden animal products. In Hindi, it can be translated as सब्ज़ी.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • Veggie: This is a more casual term used to refer to vegetables or sometimes vegetarian meals or diets.  \n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: She loves cooking and always comes up with the most delicious veggie recipes.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t

                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: Non-vegetarian food items include chicken, fish, and beef, among others.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t

                        Select the most appropriate idiomatic expression to fill in the blank.

                        \n\n

                        Our Director took a meeting and asked us to express our views on ___________ of the new HR policy. 

                        \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "the bandwagon"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "the pros and cons"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "the hook"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "the ups and downs"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. 'the pros and cons'.
                        \nKey Points\n\n
                          \n\t
                        • The phrase "the pros and cons" refers to the advantages and disadvantages of something.("भला - बुरा")\n\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • - Example: Before making any decision, it is important to weigh the pros and cons.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • "The pros and cons" is the correct phrase to use in this context because it suggests evaluating both positive and negative aspects of the new HR policy. \n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: The team discussed the pros and cons of implementing flexible working hours.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n
                        \n\n

                        Therefore, the correct answer is- the pros and cons.

                        \nAdditional Information\n\n
                          \n\t
                        • "The bandwagon"  refers to joining others in doing something that has become fashionable or popular.(कुछ ऐसा करने में दूसरों के साथ शामिल होना है जो फैशनेबल या लोकप्रिय हो गया है।) \n\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: Many companies jumped on the bandwagon of remote working during the pandemic.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • "The hook" usually refers to something that is designed to catch someone's attention or interest.(कुछ ऐसा जो किसी का ध्यान या रुचि आकर्षित करने के लिए बनाया गया हो)\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: The catchy chorus of the song serves as a hook to keep listeners engaged.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • "The ups and downs" refers to the positive and negative events or periods in life or a situation.(जीवन या किसी स्थिति में सकारात्मक और नकारात्मक घटनाएं या अवधि।)\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: Every business experiences its ups and downs, but perseverance is key to success.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n

                        \nSelect the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

                        \n\n

                        Credit

                        \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Litigate"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Install"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Debit"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Impute"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is Option 3 i.e. Debit.
                        \nKey Points\n\n
                          \n\t
                        • The word 'Credit' refers to the addition of an amount to a bank account or the acknowledgment of someone's contribution to something.\n\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: If you receive your salary, it is credited to your bank account.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • The correct antonym, 'Debit', refers to the withdrawal of an amount from a bank account.\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: When you buy something using your debit card, the amount is debited from your account.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n
                        \n\n

                        Therefore, the correct answer is- Debit.

                        \n Additional Information\n\n
                          \n\t
                        • Litigate: To engage in legal proceedings. 
                          • \n\t
                        • Install: To set up or establish something, especially software or machinery.
                          • \n\t
                        • Impute: To attribute or ascribe something, especially fault or blame, to someone.
                          • \n

                        Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

                        \n\n

                        We’ve sent a very strong protest letter. That should make them sit up and take notice. 

                        \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Follow"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Attend"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Observe"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Consider"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is Option 4 i.e. Consider.
                        \n Key Points\n\n
                          \n\t
                        • The phrase "sit up and take notice" means to pay careful attention to something or someone because they are interesting or important. \n\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: When the new CEO implemented the innovative policy, it made the whole industry sit up and take notice.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • The word "Consider" means to think carefully about something, typically before making a decision. \n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: Before buying the house, they considered all its pros and cons.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • Therefore, the correct answer is- Consider.
                          • \n
                        \n Additional Information\n\n
                          \n\t
                        •  Follow means to go or come after a person or thing proceeding ahead. \n\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          •  Example: She followed the instructions carefully to assemble the furniture.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • Attend means to be present at an event, meeting, or function.\n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: He attended the conference to gain insights into the latest industry trends.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n\t
                        • Observe means to notice or perceive (something) and register it as being significant. \n\t
                            \n\t\t
                          • Example: The scientist observed the reactions under the microscope carefully.
                            • \n\t
                          \n\t
                          • \n
